newsitem.title: USA: Reward offered for arsonist in Miller house fire.
newsitem.headline: Reward offered for arsonist in Miller house fire.

text.p: The fire that destroyed basketball star Reggie Miller's new $2.5 million home two months ago was arson, fire officials said on Monday.

The early morning fire on May 15 leveled Miller's palatial home in the suburb of Fishers. Fire department officials said a neighbour heard a car leaving the scene of the unoccupied home around the time the fire started.
Miller and an anti-crime organisation together offered a $17,000 reward for information leading to the unknown arsonist.
